title: Claw Follower Finger
subtitle: #930-007 · revised render of 930-007_ClawFollowerFinger.scad (designed, no reference mesh) · feature names

labels.text: G1 hub teeth: the drive finger's mirrored and moved half a pitch, so that the two mesh
M1 set-screw hole along 60°, blind under the blade: the drive's mirrored
M1's one mouth, on the hub's far side at 240°: the screw goes in and comes out here, on the bench
X1 hex bore over the follower axle's seat
B1 shank, its centreline 3.97 inward of the pivot, leaned 8.8° outward; its edges filleted R1
B1's root, filleted R2 onto the hub: the fillet ends at 39.375°, where the teeth end
T1 tip round R3.5: on the roll axis when the claw is closed

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. 930-001_ClawFinger.scad draws it and gives its features; it is the drive finger mirrored about x = 0, as its motion is, but for its hub's teeth (claw_params.scad, THE MIRROR). The page opens cut on its mid-plane. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
